title: Cheapest Gyms Tauranga
meta_desc: Find the most affordable gyms in Tauranga with no-contract options and prices from $18.99/week, plus Exercise NZ subsidy details for 40-70% off
intro: Tauranga's fitness scene is thriving, with various gyms offering no-contract options and competitive pricing. City Fitness stands out as the cheapest option at $18.99/week, while Anytime Fitness provides 24/7 access with no lock-in contract. The Exercise NZ subsidy programme offers the biggest discount available, with 40-70% off for eligible members.

sections.heading: Most Affordable Gyms in Tauranga
sections.body: For those on a budget, City Fitness is the most affordable option in Tauranga, with a month-to-month membership at $18.99/week. Anytime Fitness also offers a no-contract option, providing flexibility for members who want to try out the gym without a long-term commitment. The Exercise NZ subsidy programme is available for new members or those who have been inactive for 12+ months, offering discounts of 40-70% off.
list: Exercise NZ subsidy: 40-70% off for eligible members

sections.heading: No-Contract Alternatives in Tauranga
sections.body: Anytime Fitness is a popular choice for those seeking a no-contract gym membership in Tauranga. With 24/7 access to over 5,000 clubs worldwide, members can enjoy flexibility and convenience. Les Mills also offers a Flexi Membership with no lock-in contract, providing a premium option for those willing to pay a bit more.

sections.heading: Getting the Best Value with Exercise NZ Subsidy
sections.body: The Exercise NZ subsidy programme is a great way to get the best value for your gym membership in Tauranga.
